notes: This policy is for new mixed-topic videos (MX codes). It does not alter the existing CN001-CN100 Buffer scheduling workflow.
topics: Ô tô, giao thông và di sản
Thí nghiệm và mẹo đời sống
Công nghệ mới và triển lãm quốc tế
Tin nổi bật và chủ đề được quan tâm (chưa mặc định là viral TikTok)
Văn hóa, nghệ thuật và biểu diễn

visual_principles: Visual B-roll or original animated demonstrations matching the topic
First 2 seconds: vivid visual hook; large readable text
No full-screen static slides or prolonged text-only scenes
Narration and movement or sound design; no unlicensed music
All important text in safe zone (no lower caption strip or right-side controls)
accuracy: Clearly label archival or illustrative media
No synthetic reenactments misleadingly passed off as footage
No speculation about victims or identities in accidents

posting.scaling_policy: At most 3/day while new content quality is unverified; consider 4-5/day only after multiple 55-59s clips pass individual full MP4, natural voice, licensed footage/music, nonduplication and live audience-quality checks. Never treat 25 ideas/day as 25 publishable videos.

human_first_style.creative_goal: Tự nhiên như vlog/phóng sự quay thật; ưu tiên hình ảnh có người, hoạt động và cảnh đời sống, không làm slideshow chữ hoặc clip AI giả thực tế.
preferred: three or more camera framing scales
specific authentic human activity or local context
must_label: illustrative stock used for news events
synthetic realistic AI content when TikTok requires disclosure
prohibited_style: full-screen text panels dominating all scenes
30 seconds of droning synthetic sine tone without voice or natural sound
pretending stock illustrations depict real breaking news
cutting other vloggers' videos without a clear reuse licence

allowed_independent_production: separately licensed stock photos/footage with rights ledger
explicit footage-license permission from original owner

audio_quality.target: Lời thuyết minh như trò chuyện thực, rõ ràng, có ngữ điệu; ưu tiên giọng nam phổ thông miền Bắc
audio_quality.permitted_narration: Người thật thu âm được phép hoặc TTS chất lượng cao có quyền thương mại; không sao chép/giả mạo giọng cá nhân
audio_quality.no_robotic_voice: Không dùng eSpeak, giọng méo/đều cứng/đọc sai dấu cho bản đăng
audio_quality.delivery: Câu ngắn; tốc độ vừa; dừng trước và sau hướng dẫn; nhấn đúng từ khóa; không phóng đại tin nóng
audio_quality.music: Original/verified commercial-use music, mixed at least ~12 dB below voice while spoken, automatic ducking
audio_quality.ambience: Natural location ambience or actual captured device sounds where licensed and relevant; no fabricated emergency sound to suggest real footage
audio_quality.sfx: Subtle exact-timed clicks, whooshes and confirmations, not repeated nonstop
audio_quality.qa: Editor listens on phone speakers and earphones at moderate volume; fail if words unclear, mispronounced or music masks narration
audio_quality.tts_transparency: Never claim AI voice was recorded by a real human; disclose synthetic content when platform rules require it
audio_quality.audio_peak: Final limiter at -1 dBTP; target integrated loudness suitable for social playback without clipping, checked with actual meter
audio_quality.final_video: Narration, screenshots, arrows, captions and music must synchronize; final 55-59s MP4 reviewed before approval

approval_policy: NO video in MX queue may be published until all checks pass, QA flags are true and associated actual MP4 exists. Content drafts do not represent publishing authorization.

sources: reputable news and public research institutions
required_pipeline: produce new visuals and audio or secure explicit license
restricted_transformations: remove or blur watermarks, logos, titles or creator identifiers to disguise third-party footage
reframe, crop, filter, mirror, speed-shift or replace audio to pass copied footage off as original
extract frames from unlicensed videos to make an image slideshow
replicate another creator's script or distinctive sequence shot-by-shot
global_inspiration_scope.permission_based_exception: Genuine rights-cleared footage can be edited within license scope; attribution and other license terms remain mandatory.
